name: Meadows Metal Works LLC
old_description: At Meadows Metal Works, We specialize in high quality welding & custom fabrication services tailored to meet your specific needs. Whether you require MIG, TIG, or stick welding, our licensed, certified and insured professionals are equipped to handle Steel, Stainless steel, Aluminum, Titanium, Cast iron and Kirksite. From structural and precision welding to custom-made parts and repairs that other shops won't touch, we deliver reliable workmanship for both industrial and agricultural equipment. let us help you with everything, ensuring your projects are completed with precision and care.
about:
Meadows Metal Works LLC operates from Trenton, Michigan, providing welding and custom fabrication services. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but its website notes over 15 years of experience in the trade.

The shop performs MIG, TIG, and stick welding on a range of metals including steel, stainless steel, aluminum, titanium, cast iron, and kirksite. Its capabilities span structural and precision welding, custom fabrication from one-off parts to modifications of existing equipment, and repair work described as jobs other shops decline. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

The business serves industrial and agricultural equipment sectors as well as residential and commercial customers. Concrete examples of specific clients or industries beyond these broad categories are not provided.

Meadows Metal Works emphasizes that its technicians are licensed, certified, and insured, with a focus on safety and dependable service. The company highlights a willingness to take on repairs that other shops won’t touch and offers a satisfaction guarantee on every project.
